name: MINNIE
bio:
Nicha Yontararak, known professionally as MINNIE, is a Thai singer and actress under Cube Entertainment. She is a member of the girl group i-dle.

Minnie made her debut as an actress on Netflix's sitcom So Not Worth It in 2021. She made her solo debut with the extended play Her on January 21, 2025.
